input.prompt: Night, she drives; while the car moves, her eyes flick up to the rear-view mirror and hold there with faint unease, then a tiny swallow; her head barely moves. Warm streetlight bands slide across the cabin. Camera locked to the car. Anime style, consistent with the first frame, clean cel shading, same character design: same face, same large eyes (same size, never smaller), same long straight black hair, same white cropped jacket with orange bands and patches, black top and trousers; no glasses. Smooth, stable lineart, no morphing, correct hands with five fingers. Single continuous shot, no cuts. No text, no subtitles, no logos.
